name: – After § 6 – Am 3
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text: 6a. Calls for an immediate establishment of a legal framework that provides affected individuals with a guaranteed right to financial compensation in the event of natural disasters, ensuring that support is provided swiftly and without excessive bureaucratic barriers through immediate relief and advance payments; highlights the need for this framework to apply retroactively to victims of previous natural disasters who have yet to receive sufficient financial aid and continue to face hardships as a result of delayed support; demands that voluntary organisations, which are now on the frontlines of crisis response, be provided with adequate financial, material and personnel resources to ensure they are not overburdened and can continue to perform their essential roles during and after natural disasters; emphasises that such measures are critical to providing both citizens and organisations with the necessary stability, planning security and long-term support required to recover from the devastating impacts of natural disasters;
